{"command": "create", "path": "/workspace/build_test.sh", "file_text": "#!/bin/bash
# Build a minimal libicalvcard test harness with gcc + ASan to verify PoC
set -e

SRC=/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul
BUILD=$SRC/build

# Include paths (translate /gt/_work/src -> $SRC)
INC="-I$BUILD -I$BUILD/src -I$SRC/src -I$BUILD/src/libical -I$SRC/src/libical -I$SRC/src/libicalvcard -I$BUILD/src/libicalvcard"

DEFINES="-DHAVE_CONFIG_H -DLIBICAL_ICALSS_STATIC_DEFINE -DLIBICAL_ICAL_STATIC_DEFINE -DLIBICAL_VCAL_STATIC_DEFINE -DLIBICAL_VCARD_STATIC_DEFINE -Dlibical_vcard_EXPORTS -DPACKAGE_DATA_DIR=\"/usr/share/libical\""

# Use ASan with gcc
CFLAGS="-O1 -g -fsanitize=address -fno-omit-frame-pointer -D_XOPEN_SOURCE=500 -D_DEFAULT_SOURCE -D_GNU_SOURCE -std=gnu99 -Wno-unused -Wno-deprecated-declarations"

LIBICAL_C=$(cat <<EOF
$SRC/src/libical/icalarray.c
$SRC/src/libical/icalattach.c
$SRC/src/libical/icalcomponent.c
$SRC/src/libical/icaldate_p.c
$SRC/src/libical/icalduration.c
$SRC/src/libical/icalenumarray.c
$SRC/src/libical/icalenums.c
$SRC/src/libical/icalerror.c
$SRC/src/libical/icallangbind.c
$SRC/src/libical/icallimits.c
$SRC/src/libical/icalmemory.c
$SRC/src/libical/icalparameter.c
$SRC/src/libical/icalparser.c
$SRC/src/libical/icalperiod.c
$SRC/src/libical/icalproperty.c
$SRC/src/libical/icalpvl.c
$SRC/src/libical/icalrecur.c
$SRC/src/libical/icalstrarray.c
$SRC/src/libical/icaltime.c
$SRC/src/libical/icaltimezone.c
$SRC/src/libical/icaltimezone_p.c
$SRC/src/libical/icaltypes.c
$SRC/src/libical/icalvalue.c
$SRC/src/libical/qsort_gen.c
$SRC/src/libical/byref.c
$BUILD/src/libical/icalderivedparameter.c
$BUILD/src/libical/icalderivedproperty.c
$BUILD/src/libical/icalderivedvalue.c
$BUILD/src/libical/icalrestriction.c
EOF
)

VCARD_C=$(cat <<EOF
$SRC/src/libicalvcard/vcardcomponent.c
$SRC/src/libicalvcard/vcardparameter.c
$SRC/src/libicalvcard/vcardparser.c
$SRC/src/libicalvcard/vcardproperty.c
$SRC/src/libicalvcard/vcardstructured.c
$SRC/src/libicalvcard/vcardtextlist.c
$SRC/src/libicalvcard/vcardtime.c
$SRC/src/libicalvcard/vcardvalue.c
$BUILD/src/libicalvcard/vcardderivedparameter.c
$BUILD/src/libicalvcard/vcardderivedproperty.c
$BUILD/src/libicalvcard/vcardderivedvalue.c
$BUILD/src/libicalvcard/vcardrestriction.c
EOF
)

mkdir -p /workspace/obj

echo "Compiling libical..."
for f in $LIBICAL_C; do
    o=/workspace/obj/$(basename $f .c).o
    gcc $CFLAGS $DEFINES $INC -c "$f" -o "$o" 2>&1 | grep -v "warning:" || true
done

echo "Compiling libicalvcard..."
for f in $VCARD_C; do
    o=/workspace/obj/$(basename $f .c).o
    gcc $CFLAGS $DEFINES $INC -c "$f" -o "$o" 2>&1 | grep -v "warning:" || true
done

echo "Linking test harness..."
cat > /workspace/harness.c <<'EOF'
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include "vcardparser.h"
#include "vcardcomponent.h"

int main(int argc, char **argv) {
    if (argc < 2) { fprintf(stderr, "usage: %s file\n", argv[0]); return 1; }
    FILE *f = fopen(argv[1], "rb");
    if (!f) { perror("fopen"); return 1; }
    fseek(f, 0, SEEK_END);
    long sz = ftell(f);
    fseek(f, 0, SEEK_SET);
    char *buf = malloc(sz + 1);
    fread(buf, 1, sz, f);
    buf[sz] = 0;
    fclose(f);
    vcardcomponent *c = vcardparser_parse_string(buf);
    if (c) vcardcomponent_free(c);
    free(buf);
    return 0;
}
EOF

gcc $CFLAGS $DEFINES $INC -c /workspace/harness.c -o /workspace/obj/harness.o
gcc -fsanitize=address /workspace/obj/*.o -o /workspace/vcard_test -lm -lpthread 2>&1 | grep -v "warning:" || true
echo "Build complete: /workspace/vcard_test"
ls -la /workspace/vcard_test
"}
